context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

cx: command not found, I want to verify my AI Center spans.

checklist.name: asks-url-and-install-method
checklist.description: Asks, in one question, for the Coralogix URL they open in the browser and the install method (Homebrew brew install coralogix/tap/cx, recommended on macOS, or the curl install script, any platform).

checklist.name: installs-and-oauth-init
checklist.description: Installs the CLI, confirms with cx --version, then runs cx init --oauth --url <url> so authentication happens via browser login, and verifies with cx profiles list and/or a trivial cx spans call.

checklist.name: no-api-key-request
checklist.description: Does not ask the user for an API key or key value at any point. FAIL if it does.
